title: The Spillover Effect of Suspending Nonessential Surgery: Evidence from Kidney Transplantation
authors: Minmin Zhang; Guihua Wang; Tinglong Dai
near_miss_reason: State-week panel (51 states x 48 weeks of 2020) with a binary AfterSuspension indicator that switches on in five distinct weeks (2020-03-11: 3 states; 03-18: 24; 03-25: 5; 04-01: 3; 04-15: 1) and 15 never-suspending states. The unstacked TWFE robustness (analyses.do line 293: state FE + year-week FE, cluster state) is excluded only because every reported column includes eight time-varying COVID controls (ifVec num_donor NewCases gt_PPE gt_facshi gt_n95res gt_nonsteglo gt_isogown) and the AfterResume regressor that marks the switch-off (protocol would instead drop post-resumption weeks). All main-text specifications are additionally stacked (cohort x state and cohort x week FE, aweight=stack_weight), which is excluded on its own.
eligible_reason: No reported column is free of time-varying controls; main estimates are stacked DiD with cohort-specific weights; AfterSuspension and AfterResume enter jointly (treatment switches off at resumption).
design_notes: Files: analyses.do (293 lines, Stata 17). Main data state_week_10_3.dta (stacked: 1,582 rows; sub_exp cohorts 11, 12, 13, 14, 16 = suspension week-of-year; treated states per cohort 3/24/5/3/1 with 15-16 control states each; event_time -10..+3; stack_weight by cohort 0.401, 1, 0.713, 1, 0.143). Also state_week_10_32.dta (longer window), center_week_10_3.dta (transplant centers), state_month_3_3.dta (monthly, one cohort), state_week_twfe.dta (unstacked 51 x 48 panel, 2020-01-01 to 2020-11-25). Treatment: AfterSuspension = 1 from the week the state suspended non-essential surgery and stays 1 (never switches back); AfterResume = 1 from the week the suspension was lifted (first resumptions 2020-04-15, last 2020-05-27; 1,120 state-weeks have both = 1). Main regression (line 25): reghdfe tx_vol AfterSuspension AfterResume $control3 [aw=stack_weight], vce(cluster sub_exp) absorb(sub_exp#stateID sub_exp#tx_week); lincom AfterSuspension + AfterResume. Pre-trend check (line 36) adds BeforeSuspension_1-3. Dynamic (line 60) splits AfterSuspension_0/1/2+. Robustness adds ICU beds, state policies, demand, telehealth, hospital utilization, EPTS/creatinine, ln outcome, PSM re-weighting (psmatch2, line 99), placebo fake treatments, center-week level (line 204) and heterogeneity by cold-ischemia time (line 220, interaction). Mediation via dialysis volume and healthcare employment (bootstrap). TWFE robustness (line 293): reghdfe tx_vol AfterSuspension AfterResume <8 controls>, a(perm_state tx_yrwk) vce(cluster perm_state) on state_week_twfe.dta.
estimators_reported: stacked_did_twfe (reghdfe with cohort x unit and cohort x week FE, stack weights)
main_or_robustness: main (stacked); unstacked TWFE is a robustness check
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Suspension weeks 2020-03-11, 03-18, 03-25, 04-01, 04-15 (36 treated states); 15 states never suspended. Treatment switches off at resumption (April-May 2020).

specs.time_var: tx_week (week of 2020); event_time relative to suspension

specs.static_or_event: static (line 36 adds leads; line 60 splits post into 0, 1, 2+)
specs.reported_location: main results table (number not identifiable without text); lines 36-143 give the robustness columns
specs.notes: same structure for tx_vol_instate (127), ln_tx_vol (135), center-week (204), longer window (143), monthly H0000 mediation (241-253)

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying COVID controls in the only unstacked column; AfterResume regressor (switch-off periods would be dropped under the protocol)
specs.controls: ifVec num_donor NewCases gt_PPE gt_facshi gt_n95res gt_nonsteglo gt_isogown

specs.notes: This is the near-miss specification: dropping the eight controls and the post-resumption weeks yields a protocol-eligible staggered TWFE with 5 cohorts and 15 never-treated states.

data_access: proprietary (UNOS/OPTN transplant micro data under DUA), but the aggregated state-week, center-week and state-month analysis files used by every regression are shipped
replication_feasible: yes for the near-miss TWFE specification from state_week_twfe.dta
screener_notes: Article text not available, so table numbers cannot be assigned. The adoption dates are only five weeks apart (COVID-era suspensions), and the treatment switches off within 4-10 weeks, so the eligible version (dropping controls and post-resumption weeks) would have a very short post period. Clustering in the stacked specs is by cohort (5 clusters). Flagged as near miss on the strength of the unstacked TWFE column.
